pretreatment: Ultrasonic bath in acetone and deionized water for 10 and 5 min, respectively. Immersion in 10% hydrofluoric acid solution for 5 min to remove native silicon oxide layer. Cleaning with piranha solution (H2SO4/H2O2, volume ratio 7:3) for 20 min to remove organic contaminants and produce a hydroxylic surface. Rinsed in deionized (DI) water and dried under an argon atmosphere.
evidence: Prior to deposition, the silicon and stainless-steel substrates were cleaned in an ultrasonic bath in acetone and deionized water for 10 and 5 min, respectively. To remove the native silicon oxide layer, the silicon substrates were immersed for 5 min in 10% hydrofluoric acid solution(HF). Then, silicon substrates were cleaned using piranha solution (H2SO4/H2O2, volume ratio 7:3) for 20 min to remove organic contaminants and produce a hydroxylic surface. Finally, the silicon substrates were rinsed in deionized (DI) water and dried under an argon atmosphere.
